measurement: One visit is one examination of an ordered pair of captured left and right row occurrences for equality-key or temporal matching. Re-examination counts again. Equal row values and repeated input targets do not collapse occurrences. Repeated authored on conditions within a visit do not multiply pair visits; their evaluation cost remains physical work.
fallback: L * R for checked nonnegative safe-integer operand row upper bounds, conditional on a selected implementation that examines each ordered occurrence pair at most once. The scope includes pairs rejected by equality keys, NULL keys or temporal predicates, not only matches or emitted rows. Semi and anti output bounds do not reduce this fallback.
empty: An established zero operand bound gives zero pair visits even if the other bound is unknown. This does not skip mandatory whole-input endpoint or clock validation. Unknown is not zero.
arithmetic: Validate supplied operand bounds before multiplication. Compute exactly, rejecting overflow beyond 9007199254740991 without rounding or saturation. A missing or overflowing fallback is not a language prohibition: another admitted finite search bound with its applicability conditions may be used. Without one, search resolution remains incomplete.
ownership: Bind the ceiling and every operand-bound dependency to the same checked interval operation, ordered input occurrences, effective Parameter binding and producer contexts. Equal numbers, a foreign producer or an output-row guard cannot substitute for search evidence. Imported operands retain their original producer dependencies.
enforcement: Select a finite search ceiling before matching and count every pair visit within that scope. Equality with the ceiling is permitted; exceeding it fails atomically without a partial successful result. A tighter bound requires its own admitted applicability evidence. A strategy that can revisit pairs cannot claim the product fallback without bounding those extra visits.
separation: Pair visits are not output rows, CPU instructions, elapsed time, endpoint-admission work, sorting or index-construction work, bytes or retained memory. Resolve output ceilings independently and retain separate physical preparation and execution budgets. A pair ceiling of zero is not permission to omit input validation or resource enforcement.
authority: This semantic contract is not an observed count, executable bound-proof registration, implementation conformance attestation or execution permit. An unresolved search obligation remains unresolved until its bound, dependencies and realization conditions are connected. No new authored option or implicit default is introduced.
